messages:
sophie.partnerships: AuroraCompute just uploaded the co-branded asset bundle for the cloud marketplace listing + 1-pager case study. Asking for a quick QA on logos, color usage, and the one-line customer highlight. Can folks do a pass by Wed 12pm PT?

ankit.design: quick skim 10: logo SVGs are good but their secondary gradient breaks our accessibility contrast on dark mode. I exported a flattened version and a monochrome lockup in Figma: https://figma.com/file/ghijk/aurora-redwood-lockups. Recommend using the monochrome for small sizes.

jess.marketing: Brief headline suggestion: "Redwood + AuroraCompute: inference on demand." Short, but we might need a stronger benefit line. Also need a 20-word summary for marketplace meta. I'll draft two variants and post.

omar.prod: Case study has a "40% cost savings" stat but the underlying test used a smaller model and 4x batch. We should change language to "up to 40% for selected workloads" and add a tooltip/caption with test config. Example caption: `Test harness: 16x A100 v4, model=redwood-medium, batch=4, dataset=standard-llm-testset`.

leah.legal: Two legal notes: 1) we need a signed co-brand license + explicit customer consent for the quote before publish. 2) Marketplace requires a disclaimer under any customer result: "Results may vary; see full terms." I'll send a short addendum template.

infra-bot: Heads up: Marketplace asset checklist incomplete (missing signed license, accessibility checks). See: https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist. Deadline: 48h.

sophie.partnerships: Thanks 10. Plan: ankit to finalize Figma exports, jess to post 2 headline/summary options, omar to provide the sanitized test caption + updated phrasing, leah to request signatures. Target: ready for upload Thu afternoon so we can submit to marketplace by Friday. If anyone can't hit Wed noon, please DM.

ankit.design: I'll post final exports (SVG, PNG @2x, mono) and color guidance by EOD today.

jess.marketing: Drafts incoming in 30m. I'll include one variant with a clear cost/latency benefit and one more conservative.

omar.prod: I'll scrub the test logs and attach the short config note. Keep me honest on wording.

leah.legal: I'll ping AuroraCompute legal for the signature template and follow up with the customer consent checkbox language.

sophie.partnerships: Great 70 10. Adding a 30-min sync Thu 10am PT to finalize any last comments. /remind me to follow up Thu 9am.
